notes: The Cypress Flats Fire is fictional. All fire behavior, calls, units, closures, evacuations, shelters and movements are invented.
Real geography (OpenStreetMap road network for northeast Tampa) provides realistic operating conditions only.
Station, shelter, hospital and command-post names are exercise placeholders and do not represent real facilities.
The active fire area reuses the exercise ground-access restriction: ground units cannot route through it while it is active.
